purpose: Privacy-safe QRFY command catalog for read-only Windows Recovery Environment diagnosis after a failing-disk preservation workflow.

privacy_contract.notes: Repository commands and classifications are reusable; machine-specific output stays local or in the operator's private evidence store.

commands.purpose: Confirm that the current recovery shell is Windows cmd.exe before sending Windows-native probes.
Read firmware and baseboard identity exposed by WinRE without touching the source filesystem.
Compare physical-disk enumeration with retained volume objects before any filesystem repair.

commands.command: for %d in (C D E F G H) do @if exist %d:\Windows\System32\config\SYSTEM echo WIN=%d:
commands.purpose: Look for an accessible offline Windows SYSTEM hive; no output is inconclusive and must not be treated as proof that Windows is absent.
Distinguish a BitLocker lock from an unlocked volume whose backing device or filesystem is unavailable.

commands.command_template: pnputil /enum-devices /connected /class DiskDrive & mountvol {drive}: /L & fsutil fsinfo volumeinfo {drive}:
commands.purpose: Check current disk-device presence and volume mapping before permitting repair writes.

when.directory_probe: A device which does not exist was specified.

transition_rules.proof_boundary: An unlocked BitLocker volume object is not proof that the physical disk or filesystem backing it is currently available.

systemrescue_handoff.source_ro_semantics: If the recovery workflow intentionally used blockdev --setro, a later Linux RO=1 observation is expected host protection and is not by itself proof of a controller-enforced read-only failure.
required_before_winre: recovery destination and image artifacts verified
read-only image mount stack cleanly detached
source returned to protected read-only state
recovery destination disconnected before Windows repair
systemrescue_handoff.winre_write_gate: Do not authorize CHKDSK, Startup Repair, Reset, formatting, partition mutation, or reinstall until WinRE proves current physical-device presence and the intended volume is addressable.
